summary: Specifies the original Lightweight Directory Access Protocol, a lighter way to reach an X.500 Directory without the heavy resource needs of the full Directory Access Protocol. It was a standards-track specification. It is now historic and was replaced by RFC 1777, RFC 3494.

eli5.summary: A big library has a complicated desk process for finding a book. This memo describes a quick, simple window where you can ask the librarian the same questions.
